result.rationale: The server-side ZAddGuestsInputSchema (addGuests.schema.ts) is only z.array(z.string().email()) with no refinement, and the handler filters guests against existing attendees and a blacklist but never dedupes within the input array itself. The uniqueness check exists only in the client-side ZAddGuestsInputSchema in AddGuestsDialog.tsx. A direct API call with duplicate emails would pass validation and prisma createMany would create duplicate attendee rows. This is a real server-side validation gap, though it requires bypassing the UI, so confidence is moderate.
